verdict.rationale: Swell is an API-first commerce platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask. The evidence pack documents a REST backend API, official libraries, authentication and a changelog of feature additions. None of it mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
